tieNotices.message: {{cells}} match two versions equally — {{a}} and {{b}}. They'll see {{a}}, the older one.
tieNotices.fix: Narrow one version's audience so each reader has one best match.

lintIssues.placeholderBlockFix: Select the block and type the real text, or clear the field if it’s optional.
lintIssues.placeholderItemFix: Select the block, open {{noun}} {{num}}, and replace it with the real text — or remove that {{noun}}.
lintIssues.longFix: Fine if this is the source’s exact wording. Otherwise shorten it, or move long passages into a Text block.
lintIssues.noTitleFix: Open Page settings and enter a title.
lintIssues.noAudience: No audience is set, so every role (students, parents and school staff) will see this page.
lintIssues.noAudienceFix: Open Page settings → “Who is this for?” and pick the roles this page is written for.
lintIssues.noHero: The page has no Title block.
lintIssues.noHeroFix: Add block → Title, then move it to the top.
lintIssues.multiHero: There are {{count}} Title blocks — a page has exactly one.
lintIssues.multiHeroFix: Delete the extra Title block (this one).
lintIssues.heroNotFirstFix: Use the ↑ arrow to move it to the top of the page.
lintIssues.heroEmptyFix: Select it and type the page title.
lintIssues.noRecs: The page doesn’t end with Recommendations.
lintIssues.noRecsFix: Add block → Recommendations. It fills itself in from the page’s tags.
lintIssues.multiRecs: There are {{count}} Recommendations blocks — keep one.
lintIssues.recsNotLastFix: Use the ↓ arrow to move it to the bottom.
lintIssues.calloutLong: {{name}} is long for a callout ({{count}} words; callouts read best under 60).
lintIssues.accordionSummaryLong: {{name}}: the summary of “{{title}}” is long ({{count}} words; aim for under 20 — it shows before the card is opened).
lintIssues.accordionSummaryLongFix: Shorten the summary — the full text belongs in Details.
lintIssues.accordionDetailsLong: {{name}}: the details of “{{title}}” are long ({{count}} words; aim for under 60).
lintIssues.cardLong: {{name}}: card “{{title}}” is long ({{count}} words; cards read best under 45).
lintIssues.imageNoUrlFix: Select the block and upload an image or paste its URL.
lintIssues.imageNoAlt: {{name}} has no alt text, so screen-reader users won’t know what it shows.
lintIssues.imageNoAltFix: Select the block and describe the image in “Alt text” (or use the AI suggestion).
lintIssues.galleryNoUrlFix: Select the block and upload the image, or remove that slot.
lintIssues.galleryNoAltFix: Select the block and describe the image in its alt text field.
lintIssues.videoNoUrlFix: Select the block and paste a YouTube, Vimeo, or .mp4 link.
lintIssues.linkNoUrl: {{name}}: the link “{{title}}” has no web address.
lintIssues.linkNoUrlFix: Select the block and paste the organization’s URL, or remove the link.
lintIssues.resourceEmptyFix: Select the block and pick the SchoolKit guides to show, or delete it.
lintIssues.referenceNoNameFix: Select the block and enter the source’s title, or remove it.
lintIssues.tableRowEmptyFix: Select the block and fill in the row, or remove it.

translate.title: Spanish version from a translation
translate.subtitle: Attach the translator's file for “{{label}}”. Each text on this page is matched to its translation in the file, and the layout, images and links are copied as they are. Nothing is translated by AI.
translate.attachHint: Word, PDF or text files. Several files are read in order, as one translation.
translate.saveFirst: Save your changes to this version first — the translation is matched against the saved page.
translate.notFromEnglish: Translations are made from an English version. Switch to the English version of this topic to add one.
translate.needsText: Attach a file with the translation text.

notices.untranslated: No translation found in {{file}} for {{text}} — it still shows the English text.
notices.untranslatedFix: Type the Spanish here, or add it to the file and make the version again.
notices.notInFile: This text isn’t in {{file}} word for word: {{text}}
notices.notInFileFix: Check it against the translator’s file and correct it here.
notices.lostLink: A link from the English text is missing here: {{text}}
notices.lostLinkFix: Add the link back to the matching Spanish words.
notices.unused: {{count}} sentences from {{file}} aren’t on the page: {{shown}}{{more}}
notices.unusedFix: Find where each one belongs and add it, or check that the file matches this version.

stale.changed: The English version changed after this translation was made: {{text}}
stale.changedMore: {{count}} more English texts changed since this translation was made.
stale.changedFix: Update the Spanish to match, then save.
stale.removed: {{count}} English texts were removed since this translation was made.
stale.removedFix: Remove the Spanish text that no longer has an English original.
stale.sourceGone: The English version this was translated from no longer exists.
stale.sourceGoneFix: Check this version still matches the English page readers see.
stale.markUpToDate: Mark translation as up to date
